answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A opal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the comet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. What survives to the vault is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
